method: Generate all source terms by ordered binary split recurrence. Hash-cons immutable syntax nodes, but find addresses in unfolded tree occurrences. Cache every term's redexes and contractions once. Memoize states(term,remaining) and sum exact outcome-by-step coefficients; horizon decreases on every retained edge.
staging: Source/input/plan/qualified source before one constructor. Complete result before reader. Plan and record each fresh reader request/response plus current caches/work.
certificateSerialization: Full JSON is ASCII-only. Plan lossless contiguous text chunks of at most300000code units if needed, with ordered assembly metadata/full identity; native checkpoint artifacts max2MiBeach/max16MiBtotal. No mathematical recomputation for serialization.
reader: Saved root/outcome profiles, exact prefix conditions, occurrence-history lex rank/select at fixed root/outcome/length, readable terms. No new redex search, contraction or coefficient recurrence.
exclusions: No source example or table import
